g.text: Fixed pre-inspection hometown and school ties
Promotion event studies | Full C08 controls | 95% province-clustered t CIs
Ties to either the provincial secretary or governor, frozen at the pre-inspection baseline. Unknown ties are excluded, not coded zero.
Hometown: same recorded home prefecture. School: at least six months of overlapping ordinary study, formed before 2012 and before current joint tenure.
Identical observations across the two FE structures within each relationship type; relationship samples differ. Gray periods have no tied observations: no estimate.
Reference k = -1 has no estimated CI. Points are not connected. Sparse tied officials/provinces limit inference; no four-post-period mean is identified.
